prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: ONE finished vertical launch poster, portrait 9:16, target 1440x2560 or best native portrait resolution. Not a mockup or a triptych.
Primary request: 为中国写实视觉小说《毕节，雨停之前》设计 v1.0 正式版发布海报，方案A“雨后群像”，可直接用于中文社交媒体宣传。
Input image 1 is a visual and character identity REFERENCE, not an edit target. Preserve the three adult male identities from this project cover: the central short-cropped hair, broad round face, black casual jacket adult man is protagonist 文文; the slimmer wavy-haired young adult man in black T shirt is 毛狼; glasses, printed black bucket hat, white T shirt adult man is 师匠. Keep these identities recognizable, no beautification into generic idols. Do not retain third party clothing logos or cartoon prints, use plain clothing with same silhouette.
Scene: Bijie Guizhou ordinary lived-in riverside city at rainy twilight, stone bridge, real local mid-rise apartment blocks and warm windows, reflections in river, purple-blue clouds with an amber break at horizon. No fantasy metropolis, no famous foreign landmarks.
Composition: premium Chinese ensemble-film release poster. Oversized beautiful ivory Chinese Song-style title in upper 25%, dramatic atmosphere, bridge with five adult female silhouettes small in midground, three male characters rendered as cohesive painterly realistic montage in middle/lower area. Protagonist largest at center, friends supporting left and right. All three should fit above footer. Layout redesigned as a publicity poster, not a duplicate of the reference. Strong warm gold / stormy violet contrast, emotionally grounded, restrained cinematic lighting, detailed painterly realism. No human-form hidden character.
Text (verbatim, only these): small upper kicker “互动视觉小说”; huge title arranged in two lines “毕节，” and “雨停之前”; beneath title “贵州 · 毕节”; prominent balanced lower release block “v1.0 正式版发布”; tagline “雨停之前，也往前走。”; clean footer line “十章完整故事 · 七条路线 · 十三种结局”.
Typography: exact simplified Chinese, professional tracking and hierarchy, perfect legibility on phone, release block clear and high contrast, generous outer safe margins at least 6%, only these texts. No QR code, no website, no invented dates, no platform logos, no credits, no watermark, no extra text, no poster frame.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: ONE finished vertical launch poster, portrait 9:16, target 1440x2560 or best native portrait resolution. Not a mockup.
Primary request: 为中国写实视觉小说《毕节，雨停之前》设计 v1.0 正式版发布海报，方案B“夜班灯火”，与河桥群像方案明显不同，以网吧夜班和真实日常为叙事中心。
Input image 1 is a character identity and painterly-realism REFERENCE only. The CENTER foremost adult man with short cropped black hair, round broad face, black casual jacket is the protagonist 文文, 23 years old. Keep his specific recognizable facial identity and age when drawing him alone. Do not use the reference's two supporting men or female silhouettes in this version. No cartoon clothing logos.
Scene: Ordinary Chinese small-city internet cafe at night in Bijie, protagonist working at a modest front counter near a rain-streaked glass window, a few quiet desktop monitors deeper inside, cool desaturated teal monitor light and one warm orange desk lamp. Outside the window: wet sloping street with amber local storefront lights and real apartment buildings. No cyberpunk, no futuristic displays. He wears a casual dark jacket over a plain gray tee, no tools, no camera, no repair props. Quiet tired but hopeful expression, three-quarter portrait looking toward rainy window; his hands naturally resting on counter, very unobtrusive.
Composition: high-end narrative film poster, one large cinematic scene across middle 65%, strong diagonals from window rain and alley light, deep petrol blue upper 25% negative space for title, subtle amber rim light, bottom dark area integrated into composition for release typography. Evocative rain, stillness, lived-in surfaces, realistic painterly illustration similar to the reference. This is a daily-life visual novel, no romance pose.
Text (verbatim, only these): upper small kicker “互动视觉小说”; large ivory title “毕节，” / “雨停之前”; subordinate tagline “夜班结束，故事还在继续。”; clearly readable lower release line “v1.0 正式版发布”; footer “十章完整故事 · 七条路线 · 十三种结局”.
Typography: professionally art-directed Chinese Song type with clean modern sans-serif support, bold clear hierarchy, all simplified Chinese exact, 6% outer safe margins. No other text, no screen text, no QR, URL, dates, platform logos, fake credits, watermark, or poster border.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: ONE finished vertical launch poster, portrait 9:16, target 1440x2560 or best native portrait resolution. Not a mockup.
Primary request: 为中国写实视觉小说《毕节，雨停之前》设计 v1.0 正式版发布海报，方案C“雨停留白”，高度文艺、安静、版画与水彩融合的东方书籍海报；视觉必须明显区别于群像电影海报与暗色网吧海报。
Input image 1 is a project atmosphere and palette REFERENCE only: Bijie riverside, ordinary apartment buildings, stone bridge, amber reflections after rain. This version contains NO people and NO character portraits.
Scene/composition: elegant warm ivory rice-paper background with extraordinarily beautiful pale gray-blue fine rain strokes, lower half holds a small detailed watercolor/gouache vignette of an ordinary Bijie sloping old lane opening onto the stone riverside bridge, rain-wet pavement reflecting a handful of amber lights, modest local houses, river, mountains lost in mist. One simple closed dark blue umbrella leaning against a rough stone wall in foreground. Rich subtle pigment texture, not a stock photo or generic ink landscape, distinctive urban lived-in Chinese small-city detail. 50% generous poetic negative space; asymmetrical but balanced editorial layout. Minimal dark teal and muted warm amber accents. No ornamental flowers, no floating magical objects, no fantasy skyline.
Text (verbatim, only these): small top-left kicker “互动视觉小说”; beautiful large deep teal Song-style Chinese title in upper half, two lines “毕节，” and “雨停之前”; tasteful thin rule and release statement “v1.0 正式版发布”; separate airy tagline “把普通的日子，认真过成故事。”; quiet bottom footer “十章完整故事 · 七条路线 · 十三种结局”.
Typography: outstanding Chinese literary-publishing design, huge crisp readable simplified Chinese title, restrained high-end whitespace, title darkest dominant anchor, release information visible and easy to read; footer sufficiently sized for phone screens. 7% safe margins. No extra text, no QR, website, dates, badges, logos, credits, watermark, or picture frame.
